title: Wiimo
tagline: AI voice ordering agent live in Gulf restaurants.
summary: Wiimo is a production AI voice ordering system deployed across restaurant chains in the Gulf. Customers place orders by speaking naturally — Wiimo handles speech recognition, intent parsing, upselling, and POS integration end-to-end.
outcome: Live in production across Gulf restaurant chains, handling real customer orders daily.

case_study.problem: Restaurant chains in the Gulf needed a faster, more accurate ordering experience that could handle Arabic and English speakers in noisy environments, without hiring more staff.
case_study.approach: Built a mobile-first voice ordering app that uses Whisper for speech-to-text, a custom intent-parsing layer on top of GPT-4o, and a real-time WebSocket connection to the restaurant POS system.
case_study.architecture: Mobile client (React Native/Expo) → WebSocket server → STT pipeline (Whisper) → Intent parser (GPT-4o + custom prompt chain) → Order validator (Zod schemas) → POS webhook → Confirmation back to client.
key_decisions: Chose Whisper over cloud STT for latency and cost — self-hosted on a GPU instance.
Built a custom prompt chain rather than fine-tuning to stay flexible as the menu changes.
WebSockets over HTTP polling for sub-500ms order confirmation feedback.
case_study.result: Deployed live in the Gulf market. Handles multi-item orders, modifications, and upsells in real time.
case_study.stack_detail: React Native + Expo (mobile), Node.js + Express (API), Python (ML pipeline), PostgreSQL (orders), Redis (session/cache), OpenAI Whisper + GPT-4o (AI layer), deployed on AWS EC2 + RDS.

title: LexAI
tagline: Legal document analysis for people without lawyers.
summary: LexAI lets users upload legal documents — contracts, NDAs, lease agreements — and get plain-English explanations of what they're signing, flagged risk clauses, and suggested questions to ask a lawyer.
outcome: Reduced average document review time from hours to minutes for early users.

case_study.problem: Most people sign legal documents without understanding what's in them. Legal help is expensive and slow.
case_study.approach: Built a RAG pipeline that chunks legal documents, embeds them into a vector store, and uses a custom prompt chain to extract, explain, and flag key clauses in plain English.
case_study.architecture: Next.js frontend → Document upload API → Python chunking + embedding pipeline → Pinecone vector store → LangChain retrieval chain → GPT-4o summarization → Streamed response to UI.
key_decisions: Used streaming responses so users see results immediately — legal docs are long.
Built a custom clause classifier to reliably detect liability, termination, and IP clauses.
Chose Pinecone over pgvector for this use case due to metadata filtering needs.
case_study.result: TODO: Add specific metrics from user testing.
case_study.stack_detail: Next.js 14 (frontend + API routes), Python FastAPI (ML service), LangChain, OpenAI GPT-4o, Pinecone, PostgreSQL, deployed on Vercel + Fly.io.

title: DumbDSA
tagline: DSA learning with a visualization engine that actually clicks.
summary: DumbDSA is an interactive learning platform for data structures and algorithms. It has a custom visualization engine that animates every step of an algorithm so you understand what's happening — not just memorize it.
outcome: Built a step-through visualization engine for 15+ algorithms with real-time code tracing.

case_study.problem: Most DSA resources either show you code or show you a static diagram. Neither actually teaches you why an algorithm works.
case_study.approach: Built a custom visualization engine in React + D3.js that animates every step of an algorithm alongside the code, with breakpoints and a speed slider.
case_study.architecture: Next.js app with a custom algorithm runner that emits step events → visualization engine subscribes to events → D3.js renders animated state changes → code highlighter syncs with current step.
key_decisions: Custom event-driven architecture so algorithm logic stays pure and testable.
D3.js over raw SVG for the visualization layer — better transitions and data binding.
Step-by-step replay so learners can go back and understand what changed.
case_study.result: Covers 15+ algorithms across sorting, trees, graphs, and dynamic programming. Used by peers for interview prep.
case_study.stack_detail: Next.js, TypeScript, React, D3.js, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS.

title: ShilpSetu
tagline: Hackathon platform connecting artisans to digital markets.
summary: ShilpSetu is a hackathon-winning platform that bridges the gap between traditional Indian artisans and digital commerce — giving craftspeople a simple storefront without needing tech skills.
outcome: Won a regional hackathon. Designed for artisans with low digital literacy — zero onboarding friction.

case_study.problem: Indian artisans create world-class handmade goods but have almost no way to sell them online — most e-commerce platforms assume tech literacy they don't have.
case_study.approach: Built an ultra-simplified storefront creator with WhatsApp-first order flow, QR code sharing, and Hindi/English bilingual support.
case_study.architecture: Next.js frontend + API routes → PostgreSQL (artisan profiles, products) → Cloudinary (image uploads) → WhatsApp Business API (order notifications) → QR code generator for offline sharing.
key_decisions: WhatsApp over email for order notifications — higher open rates in target demographic.
QR code as the primary sharing mechanism — artisans can print and share at markets.
Minimal form fields — artisan onboarding in under 3 minutes.
case_study.result: Won regional hackathon. Designed with real artisan feedback during the event.
case_study.stack_detail: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Cloudinary, WhatsApp Business API, Tailwind CSS.

title: FuelRoute
tagline: Smart CNG and EV station finder with live route planning.
summary: FuelRoute helps CNG and EV vehicle owners find nearby stations, plan routes with refuelling stops, and see live station availability — solving a real daily pain point for eco-vehicle owners in India.
outcome: Real-time station finder with route planning for CNG and EV vehicles across India.

case_study.problem: CNG and EV drivers in India have no reliable way to plan routes with guaranteed refuelling stops — Google Maps doesn't show station availability.
case_study.approach: Built a route planner that layers CNG/EV station data on top of Google Maps directions, with waypoint optimization and crowdsourced availability updates.
case_study.architecture: React frontend → Node.js/Express API → Google Maps Directions + Places API → MongoDB (station data, user reports) → real-time availability scoring algorithm.
key_decisions: Crowdsourced availability — users report queue times and stock status.
Waypoint optimization algorithm to minimize detour distance for multi-stop routes.
Progressive Web App for offline map caching in areas with poor connectivity.
case_study.result: TODO: Add user metrics after public launch.
case_study.stack_detail: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Google Maps API (Directions + Places), Tailwind CSS.
